name: Minimal techno
key_tendency: Barely tonal: one root note and a single minor 7th stab, often D or A minor.
signature: Dry, tight kick with lots of space around it
Clicky rims and shakers with small random variations
A short sine sub that answers the kick
One tiny chord stab soaked in delay
Change by subtraction: muting is the main tool
listen_for: Small details move: the shaker breathes with a slow random gain and the stab filter opens over 16 bars. Nothing is loud, everything is placed.

parts.bass:
const bass = note("d1 ~ ~ d1 ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ d1 ~ ~ ~ ~ d1 ~").s("sine")
  .decay(0.2).sustain(0).gain(0.7)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [16, stack(drums, perc.mask("<0 1>/8"))],
  [32, stack(drums, perc, bass, chords)],
  [8, stack(perc, chords)],
  [8, stack(drums, bass)],
)
